librarian.author: mitsuhiko
localChanges: checkout.sh quotes the inner expansions in trim_repo_input (shellcheck SC2295) so glob characters in the input match literally.

checkout.sh rejects '.', '..', empty and leading-'-' segments in host/org/repo, keeping checkouts inside the cache root and out of git's option parser (upstream let 'github.com/../../x/y' escape and ff-merge an existing repo).
checkout.sh exits when parse_repo fails; upstream runs it in a process substitution, so set -e never fired and the script went on with an empty path.
